title: Tribulus terrestris L. extract alleviates diabetic nephropathy through regulation of oxidative stress and inflammation: insights from in silico, in vivo and LC-MS/MS-based metabolite profiling studies.
authors: Singh, Kishan; Yadav, Karan Singh; Singh, Anurag; Bisen, Amol Chhatrapati; Yadav, Girendra; Bhatta, Rabi Sankar; Khan, Feroz; Mugale, Madhav Nilakanth; Dev, Kapil
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蒺藜提取物对糖尿病肾病的保护作用，虽含分子对接但对象为Nrf-2/NF-kappaB蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且以湿实验为主，与本课题TF-DNA结合建模无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Tribulus terrestris L. (TT) is a well-documented herb in the Indian folk medicine system and has been traditionally used for centuries to manage diabetes mellitus and metabolic disorders. However, its underlying mechanisms and therapeutic potential for diabetic nephropathy (DN) remain largely unexplored. AIM OF THE STUDY: The study aimed to evaluate the nephroprotective effects of the aqueous-ethanolic extract of TT in the streptozotocin (STZ)-induced diabetic SD rats and to elucidate the potential mechanisms, with a particular emphasis on redox damage and inflammatory signalling, via Nrf-2/NF-kappaB pathway. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The STZ-induced DN rat model was orally administered TT extract (25 mg/kg and 50 mg/kg) for four weeks. Biochemical parameters (fasting blood glucose, serum creatinine, urea, BUN, albumin), renal antioxidant levels (SOD, CAT, GSH, MDA), histopathological changes, and molecular markers (Nrf-2 and NF-kappaB) were assessed. Furthermore, in silico molecular docking studies were performed to evaluate the binding affinity of TT-derived phytoconstituents with Nrf-2 and NF-kappaB. Additionally, LC-MS/MS profiling was conducted to characterise and identify the major bioactive metabolites present in the extract. RESULTS: Treatment with TT extract (50 mg/kg) restored fasting blood glucose levels and ameliorated renal impairment by lowering serum creatinine, urea, and BUN levels, as well as albumin levels. It enhanced antioxidant defenses, reduced lipid peroxidation, and alleviated renal and pancreatic damage. Mechanistically, TT upregulated Nrf-2 and inhibited NF-kappaB phosphorylation, which are consistent with the docking studies showing strong binding of its phytoconstituents to these proteins. LC-MS/MS profiling further identified nine bioactive compounds supporting the observed pharmacological effects. CONCLUSION: The present study provided the first evidence that TT extract exerts nephroprotective effects in STZ-induced diabetic rats, primarily by modulating oxidative stress and inflammation via the Nrf-2/NF-kappaB axis MDA. These findings highlight TT extract as a potential therapeutic candidate for managing DN.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：蒺藜 (Tribulus terrestris L., TT) 是印度民间医学体系中记载详尽的草药，几个世纪以来传统上用于管理糖尿病 mellitus 和代谢紊乱。然而，其对糖尿病肾病 (diabetic nephropathy, DN) 的潜在机制和治疗潜力在很大程度上仍未探索。研究目的：本研究旨在评估 TT 的水-乙醇提取物在链脲佐菌素 (streptozotocin, STZ) 诱导的糖尿病 SD 大鼠中的肾脏保护作用，并阐明其潜在机制，特别关注通过 Nrf-2/NF-kappaB 通路的氧化还原损伤和炎症信号传导。材料与方法：将 STZ 诱导的 DN 大鼠模型口服给予 TT 提取物（25 mg/kg 和 50 mg/kg）四周。评估了生化参数（空腹血糖、血清肌酐、尿素、BUN、白蛋白）、肾脏抗氧化水平（SOD、CAT、GSH、MDA）、组织病理学变化和分子标志物（Nrf-2 和 NF-kappaB）。此外，进行了 in silico 分子对接研究，以评估 TT 来源的植物成分与 Nrf-2 和 NF-kappaB 的结合亲和力。另外，进行了 LC-MS/MS 分析，以表征和鉴定提取物中存在的主要生物活性代谢物。结果：TT 提取物（50 mg/kg）治疗恢复了空腹血糖水平，并通过降低血清肌酐、尿素、BUN 和白蛋白水平改善了肾损伤。它增强了抗氧化防御，减少了脂质过氧化，并减轻了肾脏和胰腺损伤。机制上，TT 上调了 Nrf-2 并抑制了 NF-kappaB 磷酸化，这与对接研究显示其植物成分与这些蛋白质的强结合一致。LC-MS/MS 分析进一步鉴定了九种生物活性化合物，支持了观察到的药理学效应。结论：本研究提供了首个证据，表明 TT 提取物在 STZ 诱导的糖尿病大鼠中发挥肾脏保护作用，主要通过 Nrf-2/NF-kappaB 轴调节氧化应激和炎症。这些发现强调了 TT 提取物作为管理 DN 的潜在治疗候选药物。
